# ProofCell

ProofCell is the atomic mark: a 16, 24 or 32px square whose glyph says the stage and whose fill says how much evidence exists.

`Pathwisse.ProofCell` · Marks

## Use

```jsx
<Pathwisse.ProofCell stage="learn" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Pathwisse.ProofCell" stage="learn"></x-import>
```

## Props (ProofCellProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stage` * | `"learn" \| "practice" \| "build" \| "review" \| "prove"` |  |
| `state` | `"locked" \| "available" \| "active" \| "done" \| "verified"` |  |
| `progress` | `number` |  |
| `size` | `16 \| 24 \| 32` |  |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  |
| `selected` | `boolean` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
